instruction: Candid photographic still, medium shot. In a bright ballet studio with wooden barres, the red-haired girl in a pink leotard (R3) stands on the left, holding the barre with one hand and looking back towards her classmate. On the right, the girl in the pink ballet skirt (R2) stands with hands on hips, looking forward. Soft, bright indoor lighting illuminates the clean, pastel pink and white setting.
